revision_candidates.recommended_change: Specimen-level Les Rois 2 attribution to Homo sapiens strongly supported; recheck Neanderthal-dependent downstream statements.
Split monolithic behavior into dated site/episode observations; keep motive interpretations separate.
Southwest-China Denisovan locality becomes source-supported; lineage contribution and artifact authorship remain unresolved.
Extend source-bounded directly evidenced habitual neuroactive-plant-use chronology to 25-16 ka; no ritual/religion edge.
Refine millet chronology and downweight crop-to-people-to-language proxy edges absent independent convergence.

dating_revision_candidates.note: Direct radiocarbon dating separates multiple cave episodes; no approved NOEMA date changed.
Directly evidenced habitual whole-betel-nut use extends to approximately 25-16 ka; no ritual interpretation follows.
Direct AMS dates and Bayesian modeling refine earliest secure European millet chronology; no population/language origin claim follows.

contradiction_notes: Les Rois 2 Neanderthal-leaning taxonomic interpretations are directly challenged by multi-method dental evidence favoring Homo sapiens.
A single uniform Neolithic-cannibalism model is contradicted by site- and episode-specific Granada chronology/context.
The former Southwest-China Denisovan distribution gap is contradicted by molecularly identified Bianfu remains.
A Holocene/agricultural-only framing of habitual neuroactive-plant use is contradicted by Late Pleistocene Sulawesi evidence.
Co-burial as a proxy for close biological kinship is independently contradicted/reinforced by the mixed-relatedness Semigallia burial.
Crop dispersal cannot be used as a direct proxy for demic or language dispersal; new millet chronology increases the need for independent convergence.
MobSr performance is agreement with inherited expert labels, not independently known residential history.
Human-bone radiocarbon ages can be biased old by freshwater reservoir effects; uncorrected dates require dietary-context review.
Modern neurodivergent/religiosity correlations do not support retrospective diagnosis of witches, shamans, mystics, or historical religious specialists.
recent_runs.no_change_statement: No approved claim was edited; no candidate was promoted to evidence; no historical relationship was generated; the deterministic D-PLACE benchmark content is unchanged; D-PLACE focal years remain observation metadata; and no verified redating was found for Los Aviones, La Roche-Cotard, La Ferrassie, Shanidar, Blombos, Bizmoune, Qafzeh, or Tinshemet in the review window.
